name: jev-lgtm
description: A GitHub Action that asks Jev (TypeSafe AI) whether a pull request is LGTM or needs a human review.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire } from \"node:module\"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.try: esbuild scripts/try.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/jev-lgtm/try.mjs --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire } from \"node:module\"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node node_modules/.cache/jev-lgtm/try.mjs

author: Bobby DeVeaux
